answer.answer: PM SVANidhi offers street vendors a livelihood mechanism through collateral-free working capital loans [E01], with initial loans of ₹10,000 and subsequent loans of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 accompanied by 7% interest subsidy [E01][E03]. The scheme also provides digital transaction incentives [E01] and credit guarantee support [E03]. From the same ministry (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs), the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) addresses housing shortages for eligible urban households [E02], providing pucca houses to EWS, LIG, and MIG categories through components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme offering interest subsidies on housing loans [E02].
